**What this changes, and why**

**Checks** (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/TrellaceTeam/overheard-ai/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md))

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Runtime used: Node / Bun / both

**If it touches the database**

- [ ] New numbered migration, no edit to a migration that has shipped

**If it touches metrics**

- [ ] Fixtures unchanged, or regenerated on purpose with the reason written here

**If it touches test data or docs**

- [ ] Fictional brands only, `example.com` domains, no real company, person or key
